title: Shared completion predicate result (gate A, 12 conditions, ONE work unit)
description:
The OUTPUT of the one shared completion predicate defined at _USER-PROMPTS.md:10631-10644 (LF-only numbering) and transcribed in command-center/COMPLETION-GATES.json -> gate_a_unit_completion_predicate. Produced by platform/lib/completion_predicate.py. Deliberately shaped as a SUPERSET of receipt.schema.json#/$defs/predicate_report.report so a result validating here can be embedded verbatim as the report payload of a predicate_report receipt (that def constrains kind, reducer_id and conditions and permits additional keys - checked, not assumed).

Scope discipline: this is gate A only. It is NOT the 21-condition program stopping rule (gate B). COMPLETION-GATES.json exists to stop those being conflated; they intersect only at gate B condition 21.

The four-value outcome vocabulary is load-bearing. NOT-CHECKED means no probe ran and is never folded into a pass; NOT-APPLICABLE means the unit class waived a waivable condition with a justification and is never counted as a pass. is_complete is true only when every condition is SATISFIED or NOT-APPLICABLE with zero UNSATISFIED and zero NOT-CHECKED.

unit_id.description: Work-unit id. UNKNOWN-0000 when the receipt declared none, so a malformed receipt is still reportable rather than crashing the reducer.

reducer_id.description: Identity of the ONE reducer that computed this. Two receipts for the same unit carrying different reducer_ids is the seeded failure class 'two completion predicates disagree' (spec line 11314).

verdict.description: COMPLETE = every condition SATISFIED or NOT-APPLICABLE. INCOMPLETE = at least one UNSATISFIED. INDETERMINATE = no UNSATISFIED but at least one NOT-CHECKED, i.e. the unit may or may not be done and the predicate refuses to guess.

unsatisfied.description: Condition numbers that FAILED. This is the field a caller reads to learn WHICH condition failed; a bare boolean is what this schema exists to replace.

sentinel_line.description: Terminal-state marker (AGENTS.md section 4). Open-ended prose is the main driver of repetitive-action loops, so the result always renders one.

conditions.description: Exactly twelve, always, in spec order. A result reporting fewer has skipped a condition; a result reporting more has invented one.

text.description: The condition verbatim from the spec, carried so a reader never has to trust a paraphrase.

basis.description: Why this outcome, in one sentence, naming the measurement. 'ok' is not a basis.

detail.description: Machine-readable evidence for this condition: resolved paths, recomputed digests, sizes measured off disk, failing rows.

allOf.$comment: is_complete must agree with verdict. A result asserting is_complete=true with verdict != COMPLETE is a self-contradicting detector, not a finding.
A COMPLETE verdict may not carry a FAILED sentinel line, and an incomplete one may not carry SUCCESS.
The seven structural conditions can never render NOT-APPLICABLE: waiving one is reported as UNSATISFIED on that condition instead.
